title: Define the first LLC bookkeeping workflow and accounting policy
outcome: Record the policy needed to close one representative month before implementing accounting rules.
acceptance: Owner selects representative entity workflow, initial currency, accounting basis, period timezone and opening-balance source.
Write fictional examples for income, expense, card purchase/payment, split, refund, transfer, owner contribution/draw and correction.
Record chart-of-accounts scope, precision/rounding, permissions, accountant export and cutover-review criteria.
Identify unsupported cases and decision owners explicitly; do not silently infer tax/accounting treatment.
validation: Reviewed policy decision with scenario table and owner sign-off.
exclusions: No real financial data, tax advice, live account connection or ledger implementation.

title: Specify the entity, ledger and period-close database contract
outcome: Design the schema and transaction boundaries for isolated, immutable, balanced books.
acceptance: Define entity/account ownership, principals/memberships, journals/lines, source references, opening balances, reversals and periods.
Define least-privilege write boundary, composite entity references, exact money representation and finite-value validation.
Specify posting-versus-close locking, idempotency key scope and payload conflict behavior.
Map every accounting invariant to a named PostgreSQL test; record migration and restore approach.
validation: Reviewed schema/transaction design and invariant-to-test matrix.
exclusions: No production schema deployment or additional database engine.

title: Establish the Go and PostgreSQL build and migration harness
outcome: Make actual Go runtime components and disposable PostgreSQL integration tests reproducible locally and in CI.
acceptance: Select and pin supported Go/PostgreSQL versions, database driver, SQL generation choice and migration tooling in a decision.
Provide one local/CI command using isolated synthetic PostgreSQL with cleanup and no inherited live DSN.
Add migration lock/checksum, fresh-install, replay, failure and schema compatibility tests.
Build a non-root health-only API container; distinguish liveness, readiness and absent accounting routes.
Extend CI with real integration tests, dependency review and image scanning; retain stable required checks.
validation: Fresh/replay/failure migration tests against real disposable PostgreSQL.
Go race tests, vet, container build and health-only smoke proof.
exclusions: No bank providers, remote infrastructure or pretend bookkeeping endpoints.

title: Implement and prove atomic double-entry posting
outcome: Implement the shared Go posting operation and enforce the database write boundary.
acceptance: Posting commits full journal, audit, idempotency receipt and outbox intent atomically.
Reject unbalanced, mixed-entity, unauthorized, revoked, deleted, closed-period and invalid-money input.
Identical retries return the same result; conflicting payloads reject; concurrent replay posts only once.
Posted edits/deletes fail; reversal/correction preserve history and source provenance.
Inject failures at every write stage and race posting with period close using actual PostgreSQL.
validation: Named invariant suite from JB-002 including failure, concurrency and replay tests.
exclusions: No public posting API or live-bookkeeping approval.

title: Define GCP identities, Terraform ownership and build promotion
outcome: Produce a reviewable platform plan and executable offline validation before creating resources.
acceptance: Owner selects project, region, monthly budget, recovery objectives and acceptable dispatch latency.
Define bootstrap/WIF/state prerequisites, separated service identities and entity-authentication boundary.
Terraform exclusively owns configured infrastructure/revisions; workflows promote image digests with serialized migration/deployment.
Verify private-repo protection capabilities and document a real promotion boundary if reviewer gates are unavailable.
Plan Cloud SQL connectivity/connection budget, backups/PITR, restore, deletion protection, storage access and redacted observability.
validation: Terraform fmt/validate and reviewed architecture/IAM/budget decision.
Workflow validation with no cloud mutation.
exclusions: No apply, billing creation, credential retrieval or automatic production deploy.

title: Implement user identity and entity-scoped authorization
outcome: Bind trusted user identity to entity permissions before exposing bookkeeping operations.
acceptance: Choose managed end-user authentication/MFA and safe session/CSRF/origin handling.
Every finance read/write applies entity permissions; no caller-supplied actor ID is trusted.
Runtime DB identities cannot bypass the owned accounting write boundary or perform DDL.
Test allowed/denied/mixed-scope/revoked/deleted sessions and queued authority changes.
Errors and logs reveal no credentials, financial descriptions or cross-entity existence.
validation: API authorization matrix and database privilege integration tests.
exclusions: No public signup, real bank accounts or payments.

title: Prove outbox dispatch and bounded Go worker completion
outcome: Separate committed dispatch intent, queue acknowledgement and durable business completion.
acceptance: Publisher and handler share stable operation identity and short expiring/fenced claims.
No provider/queue network calls while a DB transaction is held.
Test publish-success/receipt-failure, duplicate/reordered delivery, overlap, expiry, stale commits and revocation.
Bound attempts/backoff; preserve failed operations for explicit retry after queue expiry.
Use synthetic transport in default CI; document task-vs-job completion and scheduled publisher latency.
validation: Fault-injection PostgreSQL/transport contract suite with synthetic adapters.
exclusions: No generic workflow engine, agent execution, Pub/Sub fan-out or live provider.

title: Import statements into a review queue without corrupting posted books
outcome: Deliver one explicit statement format with account selection, preview and safe repeated import.
acceptance: Owner/entity/account binding is explicit; never match solely on last four digits.
Normalize signs/dates/money using format-specific fixtures; preserve source provenance.
Preview/import produces drafts; posted entries change only through explicit accounting operations.
Deduplicate repeated files/rows without merging legitimate identical purchases.
Validate bounded file size/type, protected storage, retention and redacted error behavior.
validation: Synthetic import fixtures including duplicate, partial failure, malformed rows and cross-entity denial.
exclusions: No mailbox ingestion, OCR, unsupported bank formats or automatic live posting.

title: Build the bookkeeping UI and transaction review workflow
outcome: Provide entity selection, draft review and explicit posting through the authoritative API.
acceptance: Create Next.js/TypeScript package with locked dependencies and generated/validated API contract.
Display entity, source, status, amount and validation errors; support splits and posting review.
No fake synced/posted claims; distinguish pending operations and confirmed commits.
Ensure keyboard access, loading/error/empty states and permission-safe server/client boundaries.
validation: Playwright synthetic journeys for review, split, post, retry and denied entity switch.
exclusions: No marketing demo metrics represented as live data.

title: Reconcile and close one month with ledger-backed reports
outcome: Prove the complete bookkeeping milestone against a fictional month and accountant-oriented export.
acceptance: Match statements, identify outstanding/unmatched items and prevent duplicate card-payment expenses.
Trial balance, general ledger, P&L and balance sheet reconcile to posted journals.
Review adjustments, reconcile opening/closing balances, close period and prove correction workflow.
Export traceable reports and review the format with an accountant before official use.
validation: Golden-month integration/E2E fixtures and reviewed export evidence.
exclusions: No claim of accountant approval until recorded; no tax filing.

title: Deploy an isolated synthetic development proof through GitHub Actions
outcome: Exercise the actual cloud deployment and recovery path only after owner authorization and configuration.
acceptance: Confirm project/billing/region and explicit apply authorization; bootstrap federation/state safely.
Publish tested images by digest, migrate via isolated identity and deploy private services/jobs.
Prove authorized access, queue recovery, redacted telemetry, connection limits and budget alerts.
Perform backup restoration and application rollback against synthetic data; retain revision/evidence receipts.
Keep production and real-source enablement closed.
validation: Reviewed workflow run/revision receipts, access tests, synthetic fault drill and restore evidence.
exclusions: No production or live bank data deployment.

title: Validate one bank provider and plan official-bookkeeping cutover
outcome: Choose provider coverage and establish evidence for an explicitly approved limited live pilot.
acceptance: Confirm institution/account-type coverage, commercial terms and selected owner/audience/retention policy.
Prove signed webhooks, connection scope, pagination/checkpoints, pending/posted removals, corrections and reconnects in sandbox.
Review opening balances, reconciliation, source evidence, accountant export and recovery results.
Record explicit pilot/cutover decision, rollback/export path and stop conditions; proceed only within that approval.
validation: Provider sandbox contract suite and named owner/accountant cutover review evidence.
exclusions: No universal provider coverage, automatic production promotion or official-bookkeeping claim from sandbox results.

title: Configure Infisical and prove scoped GCP delivery
outcome: Establish Infisical project metadata and prove environment/component isolation with a synthetic canary before real secrets.
acceptance: Record actual project ID, slug and cloud region; create dev/staging/prod folders and verify plan supports required access scope.
Configure dedicated GCP impersonation and scoped one-way sync; Terraform owns containers/IAM and Infisical owns values/versions.
Prove allowed access, wrong component/environment denial, rotation/revocation, stale sync detection and recovery.
Keep PR builds secret-free; add GitHub OIDC only for an identified need with exact immutable repository subject and short TTL.
Owner injects canary and future values separately; retain only redacted evidence, never values or tokens.
validation: Named synthetic isolation, rotation, revocation and failed-sync recovery checks with redacted results.
exclusions: No real bank credentials, broad project roles, static service-account keys or production enablement.
